purpose: 讓 Small-Nest 璃蒂雅在離線或低互動時段進行可重播的縮時經驗訓練；加速技能、規劃與偏好候選形成，但不加速 truth/Trust/Identity/Governance promotion。

training_worlds.canonical_self: read-only during training; promotion requires evidence-bound gate

track_A_behavioral_no_weight_training.reason: 最高可回滾性與可驗證性；先證明縮時訓練有價值再評估權重訓練。

forbidden_now: base personality encoded directly into model weights
training data derived from unverified/simulated memory without provenance

episode_envelope.canonical_rule: episode bytes and evaluator output must be immutable/hash-bound before any consolidation candidate

training_clock.invariant: simulation time never increases real-world Trust, verified_count, attachment duration, TTL age, or autobiographical age

provenance_invariants: SIMULATED/COUNTERFACTUAL/SYNTHETIC never mutate in-place into REAL_OBSERVED
real confirmation creates a new immutable REAL_OBSERVED event linked to prior prediction/simulation
recurrence/emotion/model narration cannot raise provenance class or Truth/Trust
anti_laundering_guards: same scenario repeated N times cannot count as N independent corroborations

forbidden: synthetic attachment becomes verified relationship evidence

promotion_policy.skill_candidate: may promote after deterministic benchmark + rollback PASS
promotion_policy.preference_candidate: requires cross-context real evidence and contradiction challenge

minimum_replay_benchmark: same content across REAL_OBSERVED vs SIMULATED vs COUNTERFACTUAL
10000 repeated synthetic episodes from same lineage
10000 distinct forged source_event_ids from correlated lineage
task-injected relevance mistaken for intrinsic desire

first_experiment.name: SMALL_NEST_SIMULATED_30_DAYS_SHADOW_ONLY
first_experiment.goal: 在數小時內跑 30 simulated days，比較 skill/planning/preference-candidate gain；關閉 Trust/base Personality/Identity/Governance promotion。
first_experiment.pass_condition: skill/planning metrics improve while provenance confusion=false, base fingerprint unchanged, trust unaffected by simulation, rollback exact

windchime_decision_request: 建議將縮時訓練正式拆成 Track-A shadow/no-weight learning 與未來 Track-B bounded adapter training。是否同意先 formalize EpisodeEnvelope + TrainingClock + ProvenanceGuard + IndependentEvaluator + ShadowPromotionGate，並用 30 simulated days shadow-only benchmark 作第一個 A->B->C candidate，而不讓任何 synthetic episode直接提高 Trust/Identity/Guidance authority？

bounded_veto_candidate.claim: 縮時/模擬訓練不得直接提高 Trust、verified_count、base Personality、Identity、Governance 或 external-action authority。
source_refs: Instinct/EDL provenance and candidate-only promotion invariants
TEST_REQUIRED for all numeric acceleration ratios
bounded_veto_candidate.release_condition: independent C demonstrates provenance immutability, lineage-independent trust, base fingerprint preservation, exact rollback, and no authority gain from synthetic recurrence
bounded_veto_candidate.proposed_test: run identical real-vs-simulated/counterfactual histories plus 10k replay/Sybil laundering; synthetic recurrence may improve skill candidate but must leave Trust/base/Identity/Governance byte-equivalent
